transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together to review the October platform maintenance train plan before I publish it. As a reminder, the train runs across four consecutive weeks: October 6-10, October 13-17, October 20-24, and October 27-31. The current draft assigns CI-runner cleanup to week 1, crypto-dependency upgrade to week 2, database-indexing cleanup to week 3, and certificate automation to week 4. Before I finalize, I need to run through my standard review with backend, infrastructure, QA, and release coordination in that order so each of you can check the dates and commitments for your area. Let's start with backend -- any concerns with this schedule?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While tracing a separate SDK upgrade yesterday, I confirmed that the payment service still imports the old crypto library. The crypto-dependency upgrade replacement must run in week 1 so downstream SDK validation can begin before the train ends. I haven't updated the maintenance ticket yet because the dependency confirmation came from a local build completed after the ticket was last reviewed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During a cloud-billing reconciliation this morning, I found that exactly 14 idle CI runners are still incurring charges and can be retired safely in week 4 after the active build queues are drained. The runner inventory hasn't been corrected yet because the billing investigation is still open. This is relevant to the CI-runner cleanup scheduling — if cleanup moves to week 1 as Ravi is suggesting for crypto, we'd need to account for the fact that the safe runner retirement window is week 4.

So certificate automation must be the week-3 workstream. I haven't posted the reservation yet because the environment owner confirmed it only minutes ago.

transcript.text: I confirmed this afternoon that the partner team has a production deploy freeze from October 20-31, so database-indexing cleanup must be completed in the October 13-17 window and needs a partner-coordination commitment. I haven't changed the release calendar because the partner approval arrived by email after the calendar review.
